verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-definable rules that fire actions automatically on events. Build Automation is described only as CI and multiplatform builds, with no documented event triggers or rule definitions. Editor scripting APIs, CLI arguments and prompt-driven AI Assistant workflows are developer building blocks or manual invocations, not event-triggered automation rules.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
